result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers keep the concept and supply full revised SVG. Both also keep the drop shadow, gradient, hairline strokes and Papyrus. Each flags Papyrus as non-portable but does not replace it. B points out that the tiny 8-unit tagline will be hard to read at small sizes, which is a real problem in use, and it aligns the tagline with the wordmark. A's note about the barely visible summit circle is useful but matters less. Neither answer covers how the logo works in one solid color. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers keep the mountain mark and the name, and both make mostly cosmetic changes: a wider viewBox, a filter region, renamed IDs, accessibility tags and a font fallback. Neither fixes the drop shadow, the gradient, the hairline strokes or Papyrus; both only mention that Papyrus isn't on every system. A edges ahead because it aligns the tagline with the wordmark and warns that the tiny gray tagline will be hard to read at small sizes. B makes a good catch that the summit circle blends into the gradient, but it says nothing about small sizes or a single-color version.
